cases.expected: NumericIndicator wrapping an EMAIndicator with barCount=1 and delegate equal to the original NumericIndicator
cases.description: Verify that ema(1) returns a NumericIndicator whose internal delegate is an EMAIndicator constructed with the original NumericIndicator as its source and a barCount of 1.

cases.expected: NumericIndicator wrapping an EMAIndicator with barCount=5 and delegate equal to the original NumericIndicator
cases.description: Check that a typical positive barCount (5) creates the correct EMAIndicator wrapper.

cases.expected: NumericIndicator wrapping an EMAIndicator with barCount=20 and delegate equal to the original NumericIndicator
cases.description: Validate that larger barCount values are handled correctly and the returned object still contains an EMAIndicator with the same barCount.
EMAIndicator should reject a barCount of 0; ema(0) must throw IllegalArgumentException.
Negative barCount values are invalid; ema(-3) must throw IllegalArgumentException.

cases.expected: NumericIndicator wrapping an EMAIndicator with barCount=2147483647 and delegate equal to the original NumericIndicator (no exception thrown)
cases.description: Verify that the method can handle the maximum int value without throwing and still returns a proper NumericIndicator wrapper.

cases.expected: NumericIndicator wrapping an EMAIndicator with barCount=1000000 and delegate equal to the original NumericIndicator
cases.description: Check that a very large but realistic barCount (1,000,000) is accepted and the wrapper is created correctly.

cases.expected: NumericIndicator wrapping an EMAIndicator with barCount=15 and delegate equal to the original NumericIndicator (no exception thrown)
cases.description: When the series contains fewer bars than the requested barCount (e.g., series length 10, barCount 15), ema should still construct the indicator without failing.

group: Multiple ema calls produce independent instances

cases.expected: Two distinct NumericIndicator objects, each wrapping an EMAIndicator with barCount=5 and delegate equal to the original NumericIndicator
cases.description: Calling ema(5) twice on the same NumericIndicator must return two different wrapper objects (different references) while preserving the same configuration.

cases.expected: Original NumericIndicator's delegate remains unchanged; the returned NumericIndicator's delegate is a new EMAIndicator whose source is the original NumericIndicator
cases.description: Ensure that invoking ema does not mutate the original NumericIndicator's internal delegate.

cases.expected: NumericIndicator wrapping an EMAIndicator(barCount=4) whose delegate is another EMAIndicator(barCount=3) whose delegate is the original NumericIndicator
cases.description: Test that chaining ema calls (numeric.ema(3).ema(4)) creates a nested EMAIndicator structure, confirming that each call uses the current NumericIndicator as the source.
The EMAIndicator should reject the minimum int value as a barCount; calling ema(Integer.MIN_VALUE) must throw IllegalArgumentException.
